properties.name: Manchester Art Gallery
properties.description:
There are multiple toilets on the ground floor. There are wheelchair-accessible toilets in the ground floor Atrium area. In addition to this, there is a wheelchair-accessible toilet on the first floor by Gallery 16.
There is a baby change cubicle in both the gendered toilet facilities adjacent to the Mosley Street entrance. Please note that buggies can be parked in the Atrium if needed as they cannot be taken into the toilets.
